notepad.title: Notepad
notepad.description: Write, search, pin and back up notes in this browser. Check autosave and external changes while preserving your current draft when storage or file reading fails.
notepad.createFirstNote: Click New Note to get started

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
items: Ctrl+S (Cmd+S on Mac): save the current note as a .txt file
Ctrl+F (while editing): open find & replace. Press Enter in the Find box or F3 in the editor to jump to the next match
Tab: insert a tab character. To leave the editor with the keyboard, press Esc, then Tab

features.title: Key Features
items: Create several notes, search them and pin frequently used notes.
After about 400ms without edits, autosave is attempted in this browser and its confirmed status is shown.
Changes or deletion from another tab are reported without immediately replacing your current draft.
View characters, words, lines, estimated manuscript pages and UTF-8 bytes.
Use find and replace, font size, monospace, wrapping and focus mode.
Export one note as TXT or all notes as JSON, or explicitly send the current note or selected text to the reading tool.

usage.title: How to Use
items: Edit the current note or create a new one. On mobile, use the note-list button to switch notes.
Check the storage status. If saving fails or another tab changes the data, you can first back up the current draft as TXT or JSON.
Use search, pinning and find/replace. New edits can invalidate an earlier delete/import undo; check the current notice.
When importing TXT or JSON, check the completion notice. An older file result is prevented from overwriting text edited while it was being read.

tips.title: Tips
items: Notes live in this browser's storage. Someone who can use the same device and browser may access them; consider this before keeping sensitive text.
Clearing site data, storage limits or blocked access can remove data or prevent saving. Back up important text as a separate file.
Closing a tab or forcing the browser to quit does not guarantee completion of the last asynchronous save. Check the saved status before leaving.
The explicit selection sent to speech and estimated manuscript count are separate features; they do not automatically delete the original note.

whatIs.title: What is the Notepad?
whatIs.description: Write and manage notes in this browser. Search, pinning, find/replace, TXT/JSON exports and explicit speech handoff remain available. The current draft, confirmed storage, external changes and write failures are distinguished. No new server storage or automatic body-sharing URL is added.

items.a: In this device's browser localStorage. There is no new server synchronization or automatic note body in shared URLs. This is not an encrypted vault that prevents access by someone using the same browser.

items.q: What happens when another tab saves?
items.a: The external change is reported while your current draft is kept. Recheck storage, then explicitly choose to keep it with the current notes. Conflicting content with the same ID is kept as a separate note, and current notes missing from external storage are not automatically deleted.

items.q: What if storage fails or contains damaged data?
items.a: The failure is shown and the affected key is not silently overwritten with cleaned data. Your current text remains available for export. Settings storage and note storage failures are reported separately.

items.q: Is my last edit guaranteed to save when I close the tab?
items.a: No. Asynchronous locks and browser shutdown can prevent the last save from completing. Check the confirmed status and keep a separate file for important text.

items.q: Can I edit while a file is being read?
items.a: A new edit, another import or cancellation invalidates the older file operation so it cannot roll back the current draft. Check failure or cancellation notices and select the file again when needed.
